channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado diz ser 'agro raiz' e critica Flávio: 'Candidato sabor agro'
item.description: Presidential candidate and former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) declared himself the 'root' candidate of agribusiness and criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling him 'agro flavor'. He positioned himself as the authentic representative of the agricultural sector in contrast to Bolsonaro's son.

item.title: PF pede abertura de terceiro inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police requested the opening of a third inquiry against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the eldest son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The request was made last week to the Supreme Federal Court, which will conduct a raffle to assign a rapporteur. Minister André Mendonça was recently involved in the proceedings, according to the source.

item.title: Lula, que promete ‘guerra’ às emendas, errou tudo na avaliação sobre o Congresso em 2022
item.description: Lula promised in 2022 to wage 'war' on parliamentary amendments and party funds, but failed to control the budget or stop the growth of these resources during his government. He also misjudged his ability to build good relations with Congress through dialogue and a strong allied base in the Chamber, as his coalition won just over 100 of the 513 seats, hindering legislative approval. These misjudgments in assessing his relationship with the Legislature contributed to governance challenges throughout his third term.

item.title: Crusoé: O embate entre Renan e Lula
item.description: President Lula and Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission party, attended their parties' conventions in São Paulo last weekend. Both are charismatic leaders with strong emotional ties to their supporters, but delivered radically opposing speeches, particularly regarding Lula’s rejection of the notion that social programs like Bolsa Família constitute 'alms', a core ideological divide in their confrontation.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Flávio encurta distância para Lula
item.description: The latest BTG/Nexus poll shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has narrowed the gap with President Lula (PT) in voting intentions for the 2026 elections. The Meio-Dia em Brasília program also highlighted the confirmed candidacies of Lula for re-election, Renan Santos from the Missão party, and Michelle Bolsonaro, though her party was not specified in the excerpt.

item.title: Mulheres somam só 22,2% de representação em tribunais superiores
item.description: Women account for only 22.2% of ministers and councilors in Brazil's superior courts, despite being the majority of the population and holding nearly half of the initial judicial career positions. The progressive decline in female representation across the judicial hierarchy highlights the 'glass ceiling,' with only one woman (Cármen Lúcia) currently serving among the 11 justices of the STF. Judge Adriana Meireles Melonio attributes this disparity to historical and cultural barriers, as well as the disproportionate burden of domestic work.

item.title: Brancos são 83,8% dos magistrados e 89,5% no topo do Judiciário
item.description: White individuals constitute 83.8% of judges and 89.5% of appellate court judges in Brazil, highlighting significant racial inequality in the judiciary, particularly at higher levels. Despite racial quotas established by CNJ Resolution No. 203/2015, only 0.5% of active judges entered through this mechanism, and the judiciary’s low turnover slows progress toward diversity. The absence of Black women in the judiciary’s top ranks underscores a structural barrier to racial and gender equity.

item.title: Lula promete reforçar Defesa com 28% da verba livre da pasta bloqueada
item.description: Lula pledged to strengthen defense investments in a potential fourth term, stating that the BNDES will support the military industry more. However, 27.9% of the Defense Ministry’s discretionary and PAC funds—R$4.34 billion out of R$15.55 billion—remain blocked, nearly four times the executive average and 30.7% of the government’s total blockage. Although the Senate approved a R$2.5 billion advance for 2026 (to be repaid in 2027), the blockade continues, and the Defense Ministry must specify by August 6 which programs will be affected.

item.title: Zema anuncia mudança de BH para São Paulo para campanha presidencial: 'Alçar novos voos'
item.description: Romeu Zema announced he is moving from Belo Horizonte to São Paulo to advance his presidential campaign, spending more time in the state capital to engage with business leaders. He will also send some belongings to his hometown of Araxá to save on rent. Zema said he aims to 'reach new heights' in the election, following his party Novo's official nomination.

item.title: Lulinha, IA e até El Nino tiram clima de já ganhou do entorno de Lula
item.description: Despite leading in polls against Flávio Bolsonaro, the mood within Lula's circle is one of concern due to four factors: the potential use of AI for disinformation by the opposition, an investigation into his son Lulinha for influence peddling, the risk of El Niño-linked climate disasters damaging the government's image, and the possibility of foreign interference in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Empresa para a qual Lulinha fez lobby pagou R$ 150 mil a Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: The company 3Structure It Ltda, for which Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) allegedly lobbied, paid R$ 150 thousand to businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of President Lula's son. The payment was made to RL Consultoria e Intermediações Ltda, a firm owned by Roberta and her father. Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça authorized a new inquiry into alleged influence peddling by Lulinha, with evidence of irregular ties to businessman Cleber Ribas de Oliveira, a partner in 3Structure It, which secured R$ 85.7 million in federal contracts.

item.title: Octavio Gallotti e a Virtude da Contenção
item.description: Minister Octavio Gallotti, who passed away at 95, was a figure of discretion and integrity in Brazil's Supreme Federal Court, serving from 1984 to 2000 and presiding over the Court from 1993 to 1995. As the last minister appointed by the military regime, he played a key role in Brazil's democratic stabilization, with jurisprudential rulings on parliamentary immunity and the functional independence of the Federal Audit Court's Public Ministry that remain authoritative. His authority, according to STF President Edson Fachin, stemmed from the consistency of his conduct, serenity of spirit, and integrity of character — not from his office.

item.title: Como os brasileiros avaliam a saúde pública após o governo Bolsonaro, segundo pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll reveals that 43% of Brazilians believe public health has improved since 2022, while 36% say it has worsened. Positive evaluations are strongest in the Northeast (43% see improvement) and Southeast (43%), while negative views dominate in the South (42% say it worsened) and North/Center-West. Nationally, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are technically tied in a potential runoff, with 46% and 45% support respectively.

item.title: Por que Milei resolveu dobrar a aposta e atacar Lula de novo?
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei renewed his attacks on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him a 'thief' and 'corrupt' during a speech in São Paulo at the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. Analysts say Milei is attempting to appease Donald Trump and align Argentina more closely with U.S. foreign policy, leveraging Argentina's economic struggles to gain international political favor. The rhetoric is seen as a strategic signal of allegiance to the global right, particularly Trumpism, in hopes of securing future benefits from Washington.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Bagre Fagundes, folclorista gaúcho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of folklorist Euclides Fagundes Filho, known as Bagre Fagundes, praising his role in preserving and spreading traditional gaucho music and his commitment to social causes and Lula’s political campaigns. The Workers’ Party also issued a statement of condolence, emphasizing his active participation in PT campaigns in Porto Alegre and his status as a cultural icon of Rio Grande do Sul.

item.title: Como será a convenção do Republicanos que pode definir apoio a Flávio
item.description: The national convention of the Republicans party will take place this Tuesday, July 4, in Brasília, behind closed doors, and may define support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid, though the party leans toward neutrality. Although the convention deadline is July 5, alliance decisions can be postponed until the candidate registration deadline on July 15. In São Paulo state, the party has already endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro, but only at the state level.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) officially launched Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy at a convention held on July 25 in São Paulo's Pacaembu, without yet announcing a running mate. In his speech, Flávio paid tribute to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, referencing his suffering and perceived injustice, and framed his campaign as the beginning of a 'rescue of Brazil' from corruption, high taxes, inflation, and alleged PT government incompetence, portraying the election as a moral battle between good and evil.

item.title: PL corre para completar chapa de Douglas Ruas no Rio
item.description: Douglas Ruas’s (PL) gubernatorial ticket in Rio remains incomplete after Rogério Lisboa (PP) withdrew, leaving the party awaiting a decision from the União Progressista federation (União Brasil and PP) by August 5 to finalize the alliance. The uncertainty weakens Ruas’s candidacy, as he lacks name recognition against frontrunners Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos). The PP is being courted by Paes’s group, while União Brasil did not commit to the state ticket in its recent convention.

item.title: Cientista político explica o plano por trás da transformação de ‘Lulinha Paz e Amor’ em ‘Lula Porreta’
item.description: President Lula shifted his rhetoric from 'Lulinha Paz e Amor' to 'Lula Porreta' at his reelection convention to rekindle the PT’s historical base, which had grown uneasy with his moderate stance, including the alliance with Geraldo Alckmin. Political scientist Elias Tavares explains the move was primarily aimed at mobilizing the party’s more militant supporters, signaling a return to the PT’s ideological roots amid a increasingly polarized electoral landscape.

item.title: O que Lula pode fazer no cargo durante a sua campanha à reeleição
item.description: Starting August 16, the Electoral Justice allows candidates to campaign, permitting President Lula and other executive officials to remain in office during their re-election bids without requiring disaffiliation. However, they must refrain from inaugurating public works in the three months before the election, using public resources for campaign advantage, launching new social programs or announcing income distribution increases, and must comply with the 'reflex ineligibility' rule that bars close relatives from running in the same jurisdiction.

item.title: Tráfico de influência: PF pede ao STF novo inquérito contra Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police has requested the STF to open a third investigation against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, on suspicion of influence peddling in the federal government. He is already under investigation for allegedly using his connection to President Lula to benefit lobbyists and companies in the Ministry of Health. The new request involves alleged favors to companies linked to Lulinha in other federal agencies.

item.title: Presidente da Fifa perde apoio da Federação Inglesa
item.description: The English Football Association withdrew its support for Gianni Infantino's re-election as FIFA president following the collapse of a plan to sell minority stakes in World Cup competitions to private investors via the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE). The move follows similar withdrawals by Wales, Serbia, and Finland, and comes despite Infantino's August 1 announcement abandoning the FFE project, which had triggered threats of a World Cup boycott and potential legal action from UEFA.

item.title: Auxiliar de Flávio Bolsonaro para área econômica propõe cortes equivalentes a 1,5% do PIB
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic advisor to Flávio Bolsonaro, proposed cutting government spending equivalent to 1.5% of GDP through measures such as securitizing active debt, creating a real estate fund with federal properties, revising state-owned enterprises, and expanding public-private partnerships. The plan also includes establishing a Superior Fiscal Governance Council and implementing a 'management shock'. Daniella is being considered as a potential running mate for Bolsonaro.

item.title: PL confirma pré-candidatura de Michelle Bolsonaro ao Senado pelo DF
item.description: The Liberal Party confirmed Michelle Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy for the Senate in the Federal District, running on a pure ticket with federal deputy Bia Kicis. Although she did not attend the convention due to hospitalization for migraine, her brother delivered a speech on her behalf emphasizing political purpose and support for her husband, Flávio Bolsonaro. The candidacy emerges amid public family tensions and underscores her role as caregiver for Jair Bolsonaro's health under house arrest.

item.title: Lula tem 60% no 1º turno em Sergipe, diz Real Time Big Data
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads with 60% voting intention in the first round of the presidential election in Sergipe, according to a Real Time Big Data poll released on August 3, 2026. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro ranks second with 23%, while in the runoff scenario Lula rises to 63% and Bolsonaro to 27%. The survey, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, interviewed 1,600 voters from July 28 to August 1, 2026.

item.title: O grande tema da economia que Lula ignorou ao se lançar à reeleição
item.description: At the PT national convention that formalized Lula’s re-election bid, the president overlooked the issue of ending the 6×1 workweek, despite its popular support and approval in the Chamber of Deputies. He emphasized five campaign pillars: education, elderly care, national defense, artificial intelligence, and energy transition. The PEC to abolish the 6×1 schedule remains stalled in the Senate due to tensions with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and Lula will have another chance to address it on August 16.

item.title: Lula fala em representatividade feminina, mas prioriza homens no palco
item.description: At the PT’s national convention in São Paulo, President Lula acknowledged that the event had not reserved speaking slots for women among the initial speakers, criticizing his own party’s organization. He made this self-criticism while opening the ceremony that formalized his 2026 re-election bid, emphasizing the need for greater female representation in political discourse.

item.title: Faria Lima e mundo político parecem mais convictos da vitória de Lula do que o PT
item.description: In financial and political circles, there is growing conviction that Lula’s re-election in 2026 is the base case, with attention shifting to the economic implications of a potential fourth term, particularly regarding public debt trajectory and fiscal adjustment. Despite this, the PT remains cautious, avoiding overt displays of optimism, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has faded from economic discussions due to lacking a coherent policy platform and consolidated team. The market has already ‘priced in’ a Lula victory but seeks clarity on the depth of fiscal adjustment his government might pursue.

item.title: As 40 visitas da amiga de Lulinha a órgãos do governo Lula
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha (Fábio Luís Lula da Silva), made over 40 visits to federal government agencies during the first two years of President Lula’s third term, all outside the official agenda, in violation of Brazilian law requiring disclosure of meetings with authorities. While no wrongdoing has been proven, the visits raise concerns about privileged access and potential influence peddling. The story was first reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Campanha de Lula quer reeditar foto de Lula dos anos 70 em ato em São Bernardo
item.description: The PT plans to reissue an iconic 1970s photo of Lula taken at Vila Euclides stadium in São Bernardo do Campo, as part of the launch event for his 2026 re-election campaign on August 16. The image symbolizes his political trajectory and aims to connect his historical base with the current electoral phase.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Ronaldo Caiado na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Social Democratic Party (PSD) officially launched Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate on July 26, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate, during a national convention in São Paulo. Caiado thanked his family, political allies across Brazil — including Goiás Governor Daniel Vilela and figures like Ratinho and Eduardo Leite — emphasizing the ticket’s role in overcoming political polarization and implementing a new governance model for the nation.

item.title: BTG/Nexus registra avanço de Flávio Bolsonaro e disputa mais competitiva
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 33% to 37% in the first round, narrowing Lula's lead from 9 to 4 points. In the second round, Bolsonaro increased from 43% to 45% while Lula dropped from 47% to 46%, leaving the president with just a 2-point advantage. Both candidates now share equal rejection at 49%, signaling a highly competitive and polarized race.

item.title: Suplente de Carlos para Senado em SC já chamou Bolsonaro de 'ogro' e criticou discurso contra a vacina
item.description: Rafael Caleffi, former mayor of São Lourenço do Oeste and now the first alternate for Carlos Bolsonaro's Senate campaign in SC, publicly criticized Jair Bolsonaro in 2022, calling him an 'ogro' and stating he 'vaccinated all of Brazil and was against the vaccine'. Despite this, Caleffi said he would vote for Bolsonaro's father in 2022 due to limited options and praised Paulo Guedes' economic management. He also defended Covid-19 vaccination and criticized political polarization.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Lula promete fazer ‘a cobra fumar’ enquanto PT evita clima de ‘já ganhou’
item.description: Lula announced a shift in campaign tone, promising a more combative stance ('Lula porreta') starting with the first event on August 16 in São Bernardo do Campo, where he declared he would 'make the snake smoke'. Despite market optimism and perceptions of Lula as the favorite, PT leadership remains cautious, avoiding any sense of inevitability and preparing for potential electoral shifts. Geraldo Alckmin, the vice president, used his convention speech to attack Flávio Bolsonaro and defend the integrity of electronic voting machines, while the PT focuses on the economic team for a potential fourth term.

item.title: Eleições 2026: íntegra do discurso de Romeu Zema na convenção que o lançou candidato à Presidência
item.description: Romeu Zema was officially nominated as the Novo Party's presidential candidate in a virtual convention held on July 27, 2026. In his speech, he emphasized his private sector background, his status as a net taxpayer, and criticized the PT administration in Minas Gerais for administrative collapse, unpaid wages, and criminal acts such as unlawful payroll deductions. Zema claimed he possesses all the credentials to lead Brazil, citing his experience with bureaucracy, job creation, and anti-corruption governance.

item.title: Ministros do STF voltam do recesso à espera de defesa enfática de Nunes Marques às urnas e de punição por uso de IA pelo PL
item.description: STF ministers expect TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to deliver a strong defense of electronic voting machines to counter Bolsonaro family doubts, and to sanction the PL and its candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for illegal AI-generated videos that favor the candidate and attack opponents, violating the tribunal’s resolution.

item.title: Flávio reduz distância para Lula e ambos seguem em empate técnico no segundo turno, aponta BTG/Nexus
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) narrowed the gap with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a potential runoff, according to a BTG/Nexus poll released Monday. Despite the gain, Bolsonaro remains numerically behind Lula, keeping the two in a technical tie.

item.title: Eleições brasileiras estão na mira da extrema direita global
item.description: Javier Milei's appearance at a Bolsonarist event, repeated verbal attacks by the Argentine president on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and growing criticism from Washington toward the Brazilian government signal a rising risk of foreign interference in Brazil's 2026 presidential election. These actions suggest a coordinated effort by the global far right to influence Brazil's political landscape.

item.title: STF retoma julgamento sobre alcance da Lei Maria da Penha
item.description: The STF will resume judging the scope of the Maria da Penha Law, assessing whether its protective measures apply to gender-based violence outside the domestic context. It will also rule on the constitutionality of restricting tax exemptions for people with disabilities or autism in car purchases under the 2025 tax reform. The ruling on the interim governorship election in Rio de Janeiro has been postponed to August 19.

item.title: PRTB oficializa Leonardo Avalanche como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The PRTB officially launched Leonardo Avalanche as its presidential candidate for 2026, following Pablo Marçal's ineligibility. Avalanche, a businessman and party president since 2024, proposes the 'iPhone for Every Brazilian' program tied to entrepreneurship courses. The candidacy is framed as a conservative, anti-system alternative, emphasizing tax reduction and clean, technical governance.

item.title: Governo nomeia assessores para gabinete de apoio ao presidente Lula
item.description: The federal government appointed Douglas Valletta Luz and Daniel Zagotta de Oliveira as special advisors in the Advisory Cabinet for Information in Support of Decision-Making, linked to the Personal Office of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, as published in the Official Gazette. The appointments were signed by Minister of the Civil House, Miriam Belchior, on July 31, 2026. This move is part of a broader set of personnel changes across multiple ministries, including adjustments in Institutional Relations, Racial Equality, Education, Health, Agrarian Development, and Labor.

item.title: Como está a disputa entre Jerônimo e ACM Neto pelo governo da Bahia, segundo o Paraná Pesquisas
item.description: ACM Neto (União Brasil) leads the Bahia gubernatorial race against Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) with 48.9% in the first round and 50.9% in the second round, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released on August 3, 2026. Jerônimo Rodrigues trails with 38.7% and 40.0% respectively, within a 2.7 pp margin of error. Jerônimo also has the highest rejection rate at 41%, compared to ACM Neto's 28.2%.

item.title: Lula tem 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro 45% em cenário de 2º turno, mostra pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on August 3 shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro technically tied at 46% and 45% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, within the two-point margin of error. Lula also maintains a technical lead over Ronaldo Caiado (46%-42%), Romeu Zema (46%-40%), and Renan Santos (47%-37%), with blank/null/undecided votes ranging from 2% to 13% across scenarios.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 48% e aprovado por 47%, diz Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released in August 2026 shows President Lula's government with 48% disapproval and 47% approval, with 43% rating it as 'bad' or 'terrible' and 37% as 'excellent' or 'good'. In the first round, Lula leads with 41% voting intention versus 37% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), while in a potential runoff they are technically tied at 46% to 45%. Both candidates have a 49% rejection rate.

item.title: Flávio e Lula são rejeitados por 49% dos eleitores, diz Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released in August 2026 shows that President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro share the same rejection rate at 49%. Lula leads with 41% of voting intentions in the first round, compared to 37% for Flávio, and holds a narrow lead in a potential runoff (46% to 45%), indicating a technical tie. The Lula government is disapproved by 48% and approved by 47%, with 43% rating the administration as bad or terrible.

item.title: Governo Lula é aprovado por 47% e desaprovado por 48%, diz BTG/Nexus
item.description: President Lula's government shows 47% approval and 48% disapproval, a technical tie within the margin of error, according to BTG/Nexus poll. Public perception remained stable compared to the previous survey, with 37% rating the administration as excellent or good and 43% as poor or terrible. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied in rejection at 49% each, while Lula leads the first round with 41% versus Bolsonaro's 37%.

item.title: Michelle agradece apoio de Flávio após crise de enxaqueca
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro thanked Flávio Bolsonaro, Bia Kicis, and Valdemar Costa Neto for their support after being hospitalized for refractory migraines, which prevented her from attending the PL convention that formalized her Senate candidacy for the Federal District. She underwent cranial nerve block procedures and was discharged on Sunday, highlighting the support from her family and fellow pre-candidates.

item.title: A piora na percepção da economia que faz Flávio Bolsonaro empatar com Lula em nova pesquisa
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) technically tied with Lula (PT) in a potential runoff, with 45% and 46% respectively, within the two-point margin of error. In the first round, Bolsonaro rose to 37% and Lula fell to 41%, also resulting in a technical tie. Economic perception worsened: 45% of voters now see the economy as worse under Lula compared to Bolsonaro (up from 42%), while only 39% see it as better (down from 40%).

item.title: Flávio encurta distância para Lula, indica Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on Monday shows that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) narrowed his deficit against Lula (PT) in the first round from nine to four points. In the simulated runoff scenario, Lula’s lead over Bolsonaro’s son also decreased, though the exact new margin was not specified in the original text. The data suggest a tightening race between the two candidates.

item.title: “Foi libertado por falha administrativa, não por ser inocente”, diz Milei sobre Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei reiterated his criticism of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, stating that Lula was released from prison due to an administrative error, not innocence. Milei labeled Lula a 'thief' and 'corrupt', emphasizing that he served time in prison, making it true that he is a former inmate.
